decisions.reason: As a certified product line close to the core heat-exchanger offer, it likely involved meaningful engineering and commercialization effort, and with no clear negative market signal management would tend to continue rather than admit an early mistake.
This multi-model marine system is already publicly associated with high quality and major market share, so both its apparent success and the firm's visible commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
The marine cooling unit was given its own webpage and fits the firm's established marine cooling business, so management is likely to stay committed and interpret any early issues as temporary.
A compact oil cooler line with several models suggests notable sunk development costs and a deliberate portfolio commitment, which in a growing industry argues for retention absent clear failure.

Although narrower than a full system, the finned tube was presented on its own page and supports the firm's broader air-cooler business, so management would likely keep it and seek more time for uptake.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are closely related to the firm's technical base and were publicly highlighted, so escalation of commitment makes continued marketing more likely than a quick withdrawal.
